- [ ] **Step 3: Add the TS promises, the pump and the close rejection**

`src/capability.ts` is the promise layer over a `JobPort`: op names `memory.regions|read|write`, `sram.dump|restore`,
`rom.header|title`, typed results, `onProgress`, the early-Done and orphan rules, and a pump that makes no native call
while nothing is pending. `backend.ts`, `realBackend.ts`, `systemsStore.ts` (`clear()` rejects pending jobs),
`ui/app/useJobPump.ts` and `ui/App.tsx` wire it; `audioDriver.ts` installs the wait that lets a CLI or Node session
with `startAudio` settle a job, pumps after the calls that let time pass, and `render.ts` and `liveSav.ts` name both
write refusals.

Create `packages/retroplug/src/capability.ts`:

````ts
// Capability jobs (docs/modular-graph-phase-c5-design.md section 6): ask a node of the running graph to read, write or
// dump something of the system behind it, and get the answer as a promise. Native takes or refuses a job at once
// (submitJob) and hands its completion back later (drainJobs, from a bounded queue): a read of an emulated system
// completes before submitJob returns, a write once the block after it has published the region (or at once while no
// audio thread runs, the CLI's case), and a device's job (an N8 cart's) on the device's own thread, reporting progress.
// This is the promise side of that, shared by every backend: the real one over the RPC and the mock over its model.
//
// The poll runs where the control plane already looks at native state, never on a timer of its own: once right after
// each submission (so everything that completed at once settles there and then), from the UI's frame tick
// (ui/app/useJobPump.ts) while anything is pending, and, in a host with no UI tick that runs its own audio thread (the
// CLI, the Node addon), after each audio-driver call that lets time pass, with a submission waiting through a native
// sleep while that thread runs (setJobWait), so `await capability(...)` settles there with no timer at all. A closed project rejects what is still pending (SystemsStore.clear,
// which a new project and every load go through): the node it named is gone with the graph, and a caller holding the
// promise learns so rather than waiting for a completion that belongs to the old project.

/** The operations, as `<capability>.<op>`; each names its versioned native interface below. */
export type CapabilityOp =
  | "memory.regions"
  | "memory.read"
  | "memory.write"
  | "sram.dump"
  | "sram.restore"
  | "rom.header"
  | "rom.title";

/** The arguments an operation reads; the rest are ignored. memory: `region` by name, `offset`, and `length` for a read
 *  (absent or 0: to the region's end) or `bytes` for a write; sram: `bytes` for a restore; rom: `length` for a header
 *  (absent or 0: the whole image). */
export interface CapabilityArgs {
  region?: string;
  offset?: number;
  length?: number;
  bytes?: Uint8Array;
}

/** A region `memory.regions` lists: its name and its published size in bytes. */
export interface MemoryRegion {
  name: string;
  size: number;
}

/** What each operation's promise resolves with. */
export interface CapabilityResults {
  "memory.regions": MemoryRegion[];
  "memory.read": Uint8Array;
  "memory.write": void;
  "sram.dump": Uint8Array;
  "sram.restore": void;
  "rom.header": Uint8Array;
  "rom.title": string;
}

/** A long job's progress: `progress` of `total` (units the job chooses: bytes for a transfer). */
export interface CapabilityProgress {
  progress: number;
  total: number;
}

// The wire shapes (native BackendTypes.hpp: RpcJobRequest, RpcJobSubmitResult, RpcJobCompletion).
export interface JobRequest {
  nodeId: string;
  capability: string;
  op: string;
  region?: string;
  offset?: number;
  length?: number;
  bytes?: Uint8Array;
}
export interface JobSubmitResult {
  id?: number | null;
  error?: string | null;
}
export interface JobCompletion {
  id: number;
  done: boolean;
  ok: boolean;
  error: string;
  bytes: Uint8Array;
  progress: number;
  total: number;
}

/** The two native calls the jobs ride: what a backend hands CapabilityJobs. */
export interface JobPort {
  submitJob(request: JobRequest): JobSubmitResult;
  drainJobs(): JobCompletion[];
}

const INTERFACES: Record<string, string> = {
  memory: "rp.system.memory/1",
  sram: "rp.system.sram/1",
  rom: "rp.system.rom/1",
};

function decode<O extends CapabilityOp>(op: O, bytes: Uint8Array): CapabilityResults[O] {
  if (op === "memory.regions") return JSON.parse(ascii(bytes)) as CapabilityResults[O];
  if (op === "rom.title") return ascii(bytes) as CapabilityResults[O];
  if (op === "memory.write" || op === "sram.restore") return undefined as CapabilityResults[O];
  return bytes as CapabilityResults[O];
}

function ascii(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
  let s = "";
  for (const b of bytes) s += String.fromCharCode(b);
  return s;
}

interface Pending {
  op: CapabilityOp;
  resolve: (value: unknown) => void;
  reject: (error: Error) => void;
  onProgress?: (p: CapabilityProgress) => void;
}

// Every CapabilityJobs alive (one per backend), for the calls that advance time to pump: a host with no UI frame tick
// (the CLI, the Node addon, the native test host) drives its own audio thread through the audio driver, which pumps
// these after each render, sleep and stop (src/audioDriver.ts).
const liveJobs = new Set<CapabilityJobs>();

// How to let time pass while a submitted job waits, or null to return its promise pending: the audio driver installs
// a native sleep while its audio thread runs (startAudio to stopAudio), where nothing else would pump, and clears it on
// stop. Only there: a host whose blocks the DAW drives pumps from its UI tick, and must never block that thread.
let jobWait: ((ms: number) => void) | null = null;

/** Install (or clear, with null) the wait a submission blocks on while its job is pending; the audio driver's. */
export function setJobWait(wait: ((ms: number) => void) | null): void {
  jobWait = wait;
}

/** Pump every backend's jobs: the audio driver calls it after the calls that advance time. */
export function pumpAllJobs(): void {
  for (const jobs of liveJobs) jobs.pump();
}

// How long a submission waits through jobWait before it returns its promise still pending: a write completes within a
// block, so this bounds only a job that is stuck (a device's) rather than slow.
const JOB_WAIT_LIMIT_MS = 10_000;

/** The promises over one backend's jobs. */
export class CapabilityJobs {
  private readonly pending = new Map<number, Pending>();
  // Jobs whose promises a close rejected while native still owed their completions: drained and dropped as they come,
  // since each holds one of native's outstanding slots until a drain collects it.
  private readonly orphans = new Set<number>();

  constructor(private readonly port: JobPort) {
    liveJobs.add(this);
  }

  /** Run `op` on node `nodeId`. Rejects at once with native's reason when the job is refused; otherwise settles with
   *  its completion, and calls `onProgress` for each progress a long job reports first. */
  run<O extends CapabilityOp>(
    nodeId: string,
    op: O,
    args: CapabilityArgs = {},
    onProgress?: (p: CapabilityProgress) => void,
  ): Promise<CapabilityResults[O]> {
    const dot = op.indexOf(".");
    const capability = INTERFACES[op.slice(0, dot)];
    if (!capability || dot < 0) return Promise.reject(new Error(`unknown capability operation ${op}`));
    const request: JobRequest = { nodeId, capability, op: op.slice(dot + 1) };
    if (args.region !== undefined) request.region = args.region;
    if (args.offset !== undefined) request.offset = args.offset;
    if (args.length !== undefined) request.length = args.length;
    if (args.bytes !== undefined) request.bytes = args.bytes;
    // What a close left behind first, so its completions cannot hold native's bound full against this submission.
    if (this.orphans.size) this.pump();
    const submitted = this.port.submitJob(request);
    if (submitted.id == null) {
      // A refusal drains too: whatever native has finished for this backend settles now, not at some later tick.
      this.pump();
      return Promise.reject(new Error(submitted.error ?? "the job was refused"));
    }
    const id = submitted.id;
    const promise = new Promise<CapabilityResults[O]>((resolve, reject) => {
      this.pending.set(id, { op, resolve: resolve as (value: unknown) => void, reject, onProgress });
    });
    this.pump();
    // With an audio thread no frame tick pumps for (the CLI's), wait here: the job settles before this returns.
    for (let waited = 0; jobWait && this.pending.has(id) && waited < JOB_WAIT_LIMIT_MS; waited++) {
      jobWait(1);
      this.pump();
    }
    return promise;
  }

  /** Drain native's completions and settle their promises; nothing (no native call) while none is pending and a
   *  close left none owed. A completion whose promise is gone (rejected by a close) is dropped. Returns how many are
   *  still pending. */
  pump(): number {
    if (this.pending.size === 0 && this.orphans.size === 0) return 0;
    for (const c of this.port.drainJobs()) {
      if (c.done) this.orphans.delete(c.id);
      const p = this.pending.get(c.id);
      if (!p) continue;
      if (!c.done) {
        p.onProgress?.({ progress: c.progress, total: c.total });
        continue;
      }
      this.pending.delete(c.id);
      if (c.ok) p.resolve(decode(p.op, c.bytes));
      else p.reject(new Error(c.error));
    }
    return this.pending.size;
  }

  /** Reject every pending promise with `reason` (a project closing), so none waits on a node that is gone. */
  rejectAll(reason: string): void {
    const all = [...this.pending.values()];
    for (const id of this.pending.keys()) this.orphans.add(id);
    this.pending.clear();
    for (const p of all) p.reject(new Error(reason));
  }

  /** How many promises are waiting on a completion. */
  pendingCount(): number {
    return this.pending.size;
  }
}
````

Create `packages/retroplug/ui/app/useJobPump.ts`:

````ts
// useJobPump - settle capability jobs (src/capability.ts) as their completions arrive.
//
// A job's promise settles when the backend drains its completion. Everything that completes at once (a read of an
// emulated system, a write while no audio thread runs) settles at its submission; a write while the audio thread runs
// completes after the next block, and a device's job seconds later, so something has to look again. That is this
// hook, on the render frame the other watchers already count, rather than a timer of its own: pumpJobs makes no native
// call while nothing is pending, so the steady state costs one size check a frame.
//
// Editor-driven, like the other watchers: a DAW instance whose editor is closed settles its pending jobs when it is
// opened again, or at the next submission.

import type { AppStores } from "../../src/appStores";
import { useFrameDivider } from "../lvgl/useFramePoll";

export function useJobPump(stores: AppStores): void {
  useFrameDivider(1, () => {
    stores.backend.pumpJobs();
  });
}
````

````diff
+      // on this thread, so the ring is drained inline and the second cannot happen here.
       if (!ctx.backend.writeRam(id, w.offset, w.bytes))
         throw new Error(`render: work-RAM write refused at +$${w.offset.toString(16)} loading smsggdj song ${index}`);
     }
````

### Task 3: `rp.n8.nes`, the real cart as a node

Design sections 4, 6 and 8 item 3. `rp.n8.nes` stands beside `rp.n8.cart-mirror` in the `rp.n8` package, which moves
to `host/graph/N8Nodes.cpp`. It takes `rp.mesen.nes`'s `midi` and `bytes` inputs and pushes them at the host's cart link
with their frames, MIDI then bytes, the bytes' flush flag carried; a `connected` control output follows the link from
frame 0; its `expansionVolume` param reaches `CartLink::setExpansionVolume`, rescaled as the UI's `expVolToN8`, at the
first block, on a change and on every reconnect. It declares `threads`, so the Pico refuses the type, and it owes the
note-offs a pause dropped. It presents `rp.system.sram/1` and `rp.system.rom/1` as device jobs, and the link runs them
on its serial thread through a real pause rather than a disconnect. The battery goes through the SD card's save file at
the menu only; a ROM upload writes, installs and boots the image, then stops streaming. A removed node abandons its job
at reclaim. Task 3 has no hardware step: the prototype's hardware smoke is recorded in the header as provenance.

**Files:**
- Create: `packages/native/src/host/graph/N8Nodes.cpp`, `packages/native/src/host/graph/N8Nodes.hpp`, `packages/native/test/engine-graph/N8Node.test.cpp`, `packages/native/test/n8/N8CartJobs.test.cpp`
- Modify: `packages/native/CMakeLists.txt`, `packages/native/cmake/tests.cmake`, `packages/native/src/graph/node.hpp`, `packages/native/src/graph/rp_node.h`, `packages/native/src/host/devices/DeviceLinks.hpp`, `packages/native/src/host/devices/DeviceRegistry.hpp`, `packages/native/src/host/engine/CapabilityJobs.hpp`, `packages/native/src/host/engine/Engine.cpp`, `packages/native/src/host/engine/Engine.hpp`, `packages/native/src/host/graph/HostIoNodes.cpp`, `packages/native/src/host/graph/HostIoNodes.hpp`, `packages/native/src/host/graph/SystemNodes.cpp`, `packages/native/src/host/graph/SystemNodes.hpp`, `packages/native/src/host/n8/N8CartLink.hpp`, `packages/native/src/host/n8/N8Host.cpp`, `packages/native/src/host/n8/N8Host.hpp`, `packages/native/src/host/n8/N8Link.cpp`, `packages/native/src/host/n8/N8Link.hpp`, `packages/native/src/host/rpc/BackendTypes.hpp`, `packages/native/src/host/rpc/EngineRpcService.cpp`, `packages/native/test/engine-graph/NodeRig.hpp`, `packages/native/test/n8/N8SdWorker.test.cpp`, `packages/retroplug/src/capability.ts`

````cpp
// rp.n8.nes, the real cart as a node (docs/modular-graph-phase-c5-design.md section 4): the same inputs an emulated NES
// takes, pushed at the host's cart link; a `connected` control output; the `expansionVolume` param on the cart's
// master-volume register; and the cart's battery and ROM as capability jobs the link runs on its own thread
// (section 6), which pause its streaming.
//
// The cart link here is a fake: it records what reaches the device, reads connected while it is attached and no job
// holds it, drops (and counts) what is pushed otherwise, and lets a case play the device's thread for a job (progress,
// then the result or the error, streaming resumed before the completion). How the real link pauses and resumes is
// retroplug-n8-test's (N8CartJobs.test.cpp). Wiring, frames, order and the param are held on a NodeRig, where a case
// reads the node's neighbours directly; the jobs, a removal and the allocation count on a real Engine.
//
// Run via `pnpm test:plugin engine-graph`, or `build/bin/retroplug-engine-graph-test "[n8-node]"`.

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "../graph/CountingAllocator.hpp"
#include "GraphDocs.hpp"
#include "NodeRig.hpp"
#include "host/devices/DeviceLinks.hpp"
#include "host/engine/CapabilityJobs.hpp"
#include "host/engine/Engine.hpp"
#include "host/graph/N8Nodes.hpp"

namespace {

using rp::host::CartLink;
using rp::host::DeviceJobSlot;
using rp::host::Job;
using rp::host::JobRequest;
using rp::host::test::DocExtras;
using rp::host::test::DocSystem;
using rp::host::test::docNode;
using rp::host::test::docWire;
using rp::host::test::Feed;
using rp::host::test::graphRequest;
using rp::host::test::HostCall;
using rp::host::test::Message;
using rp::host::test::NodeRig;
using rp::host::test::Probe;
using rp::host::test::stereoDocument;
using Bytes = std::vector<std::uint8_t>;

constexpr double        kRate   = 48000.0;
constexpr std::uint32_t kFrames = 64;

// A cart link a case drives: the device attached or not, a job held or not, and what reached it.
class FakeCart final : public CartLink {
public:
    // A slot of its own, so a recorded push copies bytes and never allocates: reserve before a counted block.
    struct Push {
        std::uint32_t frame = 0;
        bool          flush = false;
        double        rate  = 0.0;
        std::uint16_t size  = 0;
        std::uint8_t  data[rp::host::kMaxDeviceMessage] = {};
        Bytes         bytes() const { return Bytes(data, data + size); }
    };

    bool streaming() const { return attached && !jobRunning; }

    void push(std::uint32_t frame, const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, bool flush, double rate) override {
        if (!streaming()) {  // detached, or a job holds the device: the bytes go nowhere and are counted
            ++drops;
            return;
        }
        Push p;
        p.frame = frame;
        p.flush = flush;
        p.rate  = rate;
        p.size  = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(std::min(size, rp::host::kMaxDeviceMessage));
        std::memcpy(p.data, data, p.size);
        pushes.push_back(p);
    }
    bool          connected() const override { return streaming(); }
    std::uint64_t dropped() const override { return drops; }
    void          setExpansionVolume(int value) override { volumes.push_back(value); }
    void          acquire() override { ++acquires; }
    void          release() override { ++releases; }

    // One job at a time, none while detached, as the real link answers; a taken job holds the device until the case,
    // playing its thread, finishes it.
    bool submitJob(const JobRequest& request, Job& job, const void* owner, std::string* error) override {
        if (slot.busy()) {
            *error = "busy: the cart is running another job";
            return false;
        }
        if (!attached) {
            *error = "not connected";
            return false;
        }
        if (!slot.claim(job, owner)) return false;
        lastRequest = request;
        jobRunning  = true;
        return true;
    }
    void abandonJobs(const void* owner) override {
        ++abandons;
        slot.abandon(owner);
    }
    // The device's thread: progress, then streaming back and the completion after it.
    void progress(std::uint32_t done, std::uint32_t total) { slot.progress(done, total); }
    void finish(Bytes result) {
        jobRunning = false;
        slot.succeed(std::move(result));
    }
    void failJob(std::string error) {
        jobRunning = false;
        slot.fail(std::move(error));
    }

    bool              attached   = true;
    bool              jobRunning = false;
    std::uint64_t     drops      = 0;
    int               acquires   = 0;
    int               releases   = 0;
    int               abandons   = 0;
    std::vector<int>  volumes;
    std::vector<Push> pushes;
    JobRequest        lastRequest;
    DeviceJobSlot     slot;
};

void block(NodeRig& rig) { rig.host->processBlock(kFrames, rp_transport{kRate, 120.0, 0.0, 0}); }

// One block of an Engine's stereo pair, into buffers the caller sized (a counted case sizes them first).
void block(Engine& e, std::vector<float>& l, std::vector<float>& r) {
    l.assign(kFrames, 0.0f);
    r.assign(kFrames, 0.0f);
    float* outs[2] = {l.data(), r.data()};
    e.processBlock(kFrames, outs, 2);
}
void block(Engine& e) {
    std::vector<float> l(kFrames), r(kFrames);
    block(e, l, r);
}

// A NodeRig document: a feed whose midi and bytes go to a NES, to the cart, and to the cart mirror the hosts feed the
// physical cart through today (and which rp.n8.nes stands beside until it replaces it), and a probe reading the cart's
// `connected`. `params` are the cart node's param members, JSON without braces.
std::string fanOut(NodeRig& rig, const std::string& params = "") {
    return R"({"nodes":[{"id":"feed","type":"rp.test.feed"},{"id":"sys-1","type":"rp.mesen.nes","settings":{)" +
           rig.boot("rp.mesen.nes", 1) + R"(}},{"id":"cart","type":"rp.n8.nes")" +
           (params.empty() ? "" : R"(,"params":{)" + params + "}") +
           R"(},{"id":"mirror","type":"rp.n8.cart-mirror","settings":{"system":1}},{"id":"probe","type":"rp.test.probe"}],
               "wires":[{"from":"feed.midi","to":"sys-1.midi"},{"from":"feed.bytes","to":"sys-1.bytes"},
                        {"from":"feed.midi","to":"cart.midi"},{"from":"feed.bytes","to":"cart.bytes"},
                        {"from":"feed.midi","to":"mirror.midi"},{"from":"feed.bytes","to":"mirror.bytes"},
                        {"from":"cart.connected","to":"probe.control"}]})";
}

// The Engine documents: one NES, host MIDI wired to it and to the cart, the cart's params as given.
Engine::GraphRequest cartDocument(std::vector<DocSystem>& systems, const std::string& cartParams = "") {
    const std::string cart = rp::host::test::docs_detail::node("cart", "rp.n8.nes", "", cartParams);
    return graphRequest(stereoDocument(systems, DocExtras{{docNode("midi-in", "rp.host.midi-in"), cart},
                                                          {docWire("midi-in.midi", "sys-1.midi"),
                                                           docWire("midi-in.midi", "cart.midi")}}),
                        {1});
}
// The same without the cart, so publishing it removes the node.
Engine::GraphRequest noCartDocument(std::vector<DocSystem>& systems) {
    return graphRequest(stereoDocument(systems, DocExtras{{docNode("midi-in", "rp.host.midi-in")},
                                                          {docWire("midi-in.midi", "sys-1.midi")}}),
                        {1});
}

JobRequest request(const char* capability, const char* op) {
    JobRequest r;
    r.nodeId     = "cart";
    r.capability = capability;
    r.op         = op;
    return r;
}

// The completion of job `id` among what a drain returned, or a progress entry for it when `done` is false.
const rp::host::JobCompletion* entry(const std::vector<rp::host::JobCompletion>& drained, std::uint32_t id, bool done) {
    for (const auto& c : drained)
        if (c.id == id && c.done == done) return &c;
    return nullptr;
}

}  // namespace

TEST_CASE("rp.n8.nes receives what rp.mesen.nes receives from one source, in order, at their frames, flush carried",
          "[engine-graph][n8-node]") {
    FakeCart cart;
    NodeRig  rig(kRate);
    rig.devices.install(&cart, nullptr);
    REQUIRE(rig.set(fanOut(rig)).ok);
    Feed& feed = rig.node<Feed>("feed");
    // Several messages at one frame, a SysEx longer than a MidiEvent, an empty one (skipped), and bytes with and
    // without the flush flag.
    feed.next[Feed::Midi]  = {{3, {0x90, 60, 100}}, {3, {0xB0, 7, 90}}, {8, {}}, {8, {0x80, 60, 0}},
                              {20, {0xF0, 0x7D, 0x42, 0x01, 0x00, 0x08, 0xF7}}};
    feed.next[Feed::Bytes] = {{1, {0xF4, 0x00}, RP_MESSAGE_FLUSH}, {5, {0xF8}}, {63, {0xF5, 0x01, 0x02}}};
    block(rig);

    // The cart got exactly what the cart mirror hands the physical N8 today, call for call: the MIDI then the bytes,
    // each in queue order at its frame, only the bytes' flag set.
    REQUIRE(cart.pushes.size() == rig.cart.size());
    REQUIRE(cart.pushes.size() == 7);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < cart.pushes.size(); ++i) {
        INFO("push " << i);
        CHECK(cart.pushes[i].frame == rig.cart[i].frame);
        CHECK(cart.pushes[i].bytes() == rig.cart[i].data);
        CHECK(cart.pushes[i].flush == rig.cart[i].flush);
        CHECK(cart.pushes[i].rate == kRate);  // the block's rate, which the link times the release at
    }
    CHECK(cart.pushes[0].bytes() == Bytes{0x90, 60, 100});
    CHECK(cart.pushes[4].frame == 1);
    CHECK(cart.pushes[4].flush);
    CHECK_FALSE(cart.pushes[5].flush);
    // And the emulated NES read the same bytes queue: what its bytes input fed its core, as the sync trace saw it.
    REQUIRE(rig.traced.size() == 3);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        CHECK(rig.traced[i].frame == cart.pushes[4 + i].frame);
        CHECK(rig.traced[i].data == cart.pushes[4 + i].bytes());
    }
    CHECK(cart.drops == 0);
}

TEST_CASE("rp.n8.nes's connected output follows the link from frame 0, and a host with no cart plans and runs it",
          "[engine-graph][n8-node]") {
    SECTION("an installed link, attached, then gone, then back") {
        FakeCart cart;
        NodeRig  rig(kRate);
        rig.devices.install(&cart, nullptr);
        REQUIRE(rig.set(fanOut(rig)).ok);
        Probe& probe = rig.node<Probe>("probe");
        block(rig);
        CHECK(probe.controlAtZero == 1.0);
        cart.attached = false;
        rig.node<Feed>("feed").next[Feed::Midi] = {{0, {0x90, 60, 100}}};
        block(rig);
        CHECK(probe.controlAtZero == 0.0);
        CHECK(cart.drops == 1);  // pushed while gone: nowhere, counted
        cart.attached = true;
        block(rig);
        CHECK(probe.controlAtZero == 1.0);
        CHECK(cart.acquires == 1);
    }
    SECTION("no link installed: the never-connected handle, through a real Engine") {
        Engine                         e(kRate);
        rp::host::test::Roms           roms;
        std::vector<DocSystem>         systems{{1, rp::host::test::kNesType}};
        withRoms(e, systems, roms);
        REQUIRE(e.setGraph(cartDocument(systems)).ok);
        e.stageMidi(0, Bytes{0x90, 60, 100});
        block(e);
        block(e);
        CHECK(e.faultCount() == 0);
        // A job has nowhere to go.
        const auto refused = e.submitJob(request(RP_SYSTEM_SRAM_INTERFACE, "dump"));
        CHECK(refused.id == 0);
        CHECK(refused.error == "not connected");
    }
}

TEST_CASE("rp.n8.nes gives the link its expansion volume at its first block, on a change, and on every reconnect",
          "[engine-graph][n8-node]") {
    FakeCart cart;
    NodeRig  rig(kRate);
    rig.devices.install(&cart, nullptr);
    REQUIRE(rig.set(fanOut(rig, R"("expansionVolume":50)")).ok);
    block(rig);
    // 50 % of unity, rescaled as the UI's expVolToN8 does: round(50 * 128 / 100).
    REQUIRE(cart.volumes == std::vector<int>{64});
    block(rig);
    CHECK(cart.volumes.size() == 1);  // unchanged: nothing more

    REQUIRE(rig.host->setParam("cart", "expansionVolume", 200.0));
    block(rig);
    CHECK(cart.volumes == std::vector<int>{64, 255});  // 256 clamps to the register's 255

    // Gone and back: the value again on the block the link reads connected, though the param did not move.
    cart.attached = false;
    block(rig);
    CHECK(cart.volumes.size() == 2);
    cart.attached = true;
    block(rig);
    CHECK(cart.volumes == std::vector<int>{64, 255, 255});
    CHECK(rp::host::expansionVolumeRegister(100) == 128);
    CHECK(rp::host::expansionVolumeRegister(0) == 0);
}

TEST_CASE("a note-off the link dropped during a pause goes out at frame 0 of the first block it reads connected",
          "[engine-graph][n8-node]") {
    FakeCart cart;
    NodeRig  rig(kRate);
    rig.devices.install(&cart, nullptr);
    REQUIRE(rig.set(fanOut(rig)).ok);
    Feed& feed = rig.node<Feed>("feed");
    feed.next[Feed::Midi] = {{4, {0x91, 60, 100}}, {5, {0x91, 64, 100}}};
    block(rig);
    REQUIRE(cart.pushes.size() == 2);

    // A job holds the device: the note-off for 60, a note-on for 67 and its own note-off are all dropped.
    cart.jobRunning = true;
    feed.next[Feed::Midi] = {{2, {0x81, 60, 0}}, {3, {0x91, 67, 100}}, {9, {0x91, 67, 0}}};
    block(rig);
    CHECK(cart.pushes.size() == 2);
    CHECK(cart.drops == 3);

    // Streaming back: the one note the console is still holding for want of its note-off (60: 67 never sounded) gets
    // it first, then the block's own traffic.
    cart.jobRunning = false;
    feed.next[Feed::Midi] = {{7, {0x81, 64, 0}}};
    block(rig);
    REQUIRE(cart.pushes.size() == 4);
    CHECK(cart.pushes[2].frame == 0);
    CHECK(cart.pushes[2].bytes() == Bytes{0x81, 60, 0});
    CHECK(cart.pushes[3].frame == 7);
    CHECK(cart.pushes[3].bytes() == Bytes{0x81, 64, 0});
    block(rig);
    CHECK(cart.pushes.size() == 4);  // paid once
}

TEST_CASE("rp.n8.nes's jobs: one at a time, none while disconnected, streaming paused for each, progress, completion",
          "[engine-graph][n8-node]") {
    FakeCart               cart;
    Engine                 e(kRate);
    rp::host::test::Roms   roms;
    std::vector<DocSystem> systems{{1, rp::host::test::kNesType}};
    withRoms(e, systems, roms);
    e.setDeviceLinks(&cart, nullptr);
    REQUIRE(e.setGraph(cartDocument(systems)).ok);
    block(e);

    // The cart presents the battery and the ROM, not the memory (a cart-memory read is a DMA that can wedge a running
    // game, which stays with the CLI's tools).
    const auto memory = e.submitJob(request(RP_SYSTEM_MEMORY_INTERFACE, "read"));
    CHECK(memory.id == 0);
    CHECK(memory.error == "node cart presents no rp.system.memory/1");
    // An id the engine does not know is refused before the node is asked: a node answers rp.step/1 or rp.link/1 with
    // structs of their own, which must never be taken for a capability.
    for (const char* id : {RP_STEP_INTERFACE, RP_LINK_INTERFACE, "rp.system.video/1"}) {
        const auto unknown = e.submitJob(request(id, "dump"));
        CHECK(unknown.id == 0);
        CHECK(unknown.error == std::string("unknown capability ") + id);
    }

    // Detached: refused at once.
    cart.attached = false;
    const auto detached = e.submitJob(request(RP_SYSTEM_SRAM_INTERFACE, "dump"));
    CHECK(detached.id == 0);
    CHECK(detached.error == "not connected");
    cart.attached = true;

    // A dump is taken and holds the device; a second job is refused busy.
    const auto dump = e.submitJob(request(RP_SYSTEM_SRAM_INTERFACE, "dump"));
    REQUIRE(dump.id != 0);
    CHECK(cart.lastRequest.op == "dump");
    CHECK(cart.lastRequest.capability == RP_SYSTEM_SRAM_INTERFACE);
    const auto second = e.submitJob(request(RP_SYSTEM_ROM_INTERFACE, "upload"));
    CHECK(second.id == 0);
    CHECK(second.error.rfind("busy", 0) == 0);
    CHECK(e.jobsOutstanding() == 1);

    // While it runs the node reads disconnected and the link drops what the node pushes, and counts it.
    e.stageMidi(3, Bytes{0x90, 60, 100});
    block(e);
    CHECK(cart.pushes.empty());
    CHECK(cart.drops == 1);
    CHECK(cart.dropped() == 1);

    cart.progress(4096, 65536);
    auto drained = e.drainJobs();
    const auto* running = entry(drained, dump.id, false);
    REQUIRE(running != nullptr);
    CHECK(running->progress == 4096);
    CHECK(running->total == 65536);
    CHECK(entry(drained, dump.id, true) == nullptr);

    // Done: streaming is back before the completion is posted, so the next block reaches the cart.
    cart.finish(Bytes(65536, 0x5A));
    drained = e.drainJobs();
    const auto* done = entry(drained, dump.id, true);
    REQUIRE(done != nullptr);
    CHECK(done->ok);
    CHECK(done->bytes == Bytes(65536, 0x5A));
    e.stageMidi(1, Bytes{0x80, 60, 0});
    block(e);
    REQUIRE(cart.pushes.size() == 1);
    CHECK(cart.pushes[0].frame == 1);

    // A device's failure carries its reason; and the slot is free again for the next.
    const auto restore = e.submitJob(request(RP_SYSTEM_SRAM_INTERFACE, "restore"));
    REQUIRE(restore.id != 0);
    cart.failJob("cart SRAM verify failed (readback != save)");
    drained = e.drainJobs();
    const auto* failed = entry(drained, restore.id, true);
    REQUIRE(failed != nullptr);
    CHECK_FALSE(failed->ok);
    CHECK(failed->error == "cart SRAM verify failed (readback != save)");
    CHECK(e.jobsOutstanding() == 0);
}

TEST_CASE("a cart node removed during a job abandons it: it fails at once, and the device reports into it no more",
          "[engine-graph][n8-node]") {
    FakeCart               cart;
    Engine                 e(kRate);
    rp::host::test::Roms   roms;
    std::vector<DocSystem> systems{{1, rp::host::test::kNesType}};
    withRoms(e, systems, roms);
    e.setDeviceLinks(&cart, nullptr);
    REQUIRE(e.setGraph(cartDocument(systems)).ok);
    block(e);

    const auto dump = e.submitJob(request(RP_SYSTEM_SRAM_INTERFACE, "dump"));
    REQUIRE(dump.id != 0);
    cart.progress(8192, 65536);

    // A plan that keeps the node keeps its job.
    REQUIRE(e.setGraph(cartDocument(systems, R"("expansionVolume":120)")).ok);
    block(e);
    CHECK(cart.abandons == 0);
    CHECK(cart.slot.busy());

    // Its removal: the node gives the handle back and abandons the job, which fails as the node's other jobs do.
    REQUIRE(e.setGraph(noCartDocument(systems)).ok);
    block(e);
    block(e);  // the plan that held it is reclaimed here at the latest
    CHECK(cart.abandons == 1);
    CHECK(cart.releases == 1);
    auto drained = e.drainJobs();
    const auto* removed = entry(drained, dump.id, true);
    REQUIRE(removed != nullptr);
    CHECK_FALSE(removed->ok);
    CHECK(removed->error == "node cart left the plan before the job completed");
    CHECK(e.jobsOutstanding() == 0);

    // The device is still busy finishing; what it reports now reaches no record (the engine may have freed it), and
    // only its finishing frees the device for the next job.
    CHECK(cart.slot.busy());
    cart.progress(65536, 65536);
    cart.finish(Bytes(16, 1));
    CHECK_FALSE(cart.slot.busy());
    CHECK(e.drainJobs().empty());
}

TEST_CASE("a warmed block feeding a NES and its cart node allocates and frees nothing", "[engine-graph][n8-node]") {
    FakeCart               cart;
    Engine                 e(kRate);
    rp::host::test::Roms   roms;
    std::vector<DocSystem> systems{{1, rp::host::test::kNesType}};
    withRoms(e, systems, roms);
    e.setDeviceLinks(&cart, nullptr);
    REQUIRE(e.setGraph(cartDocument(systems, R"("expansionVolume":80)")).ok);
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) block(e);
    // A note the cart holds and whose note-off a pause then drops, so the counted block pays an owed note-off too.
    e.stageMidi(0, Bytes{0x90, 60, 100});
    block(e);
    cart.jobRunning = true;
    e.stageMidi(0, Bytes{0x80, 60, 0});
    block(e);
    cart.jobRunning = false;
    REQUIRE(e.setParam("cart", "expansionVolume", 90.0));
    e.stageMidi(5, Bytes{0x90, 62, 100});
    e.stageMidi(9, Bytes{0x80, 62, 0});
    cart.pushes.clear();
    cart.pushes.reserve(8);
    cart.volumes.reserve(8);

    std::vector<float> l(kFrames), r(kFrames);  // the block's own output, sized before the window
    rp::test::beginCountingAllocations();
    block(e, l, r);
    const auto counted = rp::test::endCountingAllocations();
    CHECK(counted.allocations == 0);
    CHECK(counted.frees == 0);
    REQUIRE(cart.pushes.size() == 3);  // the owed note-off, then the block's two
    CHECK(cart.pushes[0].bytes() == Bytes{0x80, 60, 0});
    CHECK(cart.volumes.back() == rp::host::expansionVolumeRegister(90));
}

TEST_CASE("rp.n8.nes declares threads, so a target with none refuses the type", "[engine-graph][n8-node]") {
    const rp_package* pkg = rp::host::n8Package();
    const rp_node_type* cart = nullptr;
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < pkg->node_type_count; ++i)
        if (std::string(pkg->node_types[i]->id) == "rp.n8.nes") cart = pkg->node_types[i];
    REQUIRE(cart != nullptr);
    CHECK(std::string(cart->descriptor(cart)).find(R"("threads":true)") != std::string::npos);

    NodeRig pico(kRate, 8192, rp::graph::Target::Pico);
    const auto refused = pico.set(R"({"nodes":[{"id":"cart","type":"rp.n8.nes"}],"wires":[]})");
    REQUIRE_FALSE(refused.ok);
    CHECK(refused.errors.at(0).code == "capability");
    CHECK(refused.errors.at(0).message.find("threads") != std::string::npos);
    NodeRig desktop(kRate);
    CHECK(desktop.set(R"({"nodes":[{"id":"cart","type":"rp.n8.nes"}],"wires":[]})").ok);
}
````

Create `packages/native/test/n8/N8CartJobs.test.cpp`:

````cpp
// Guards the cart's capability jobs (N8Host::submitCartJob, docs/modular-graph-phase-c5-design.md section 6) and the
// pause they run in (N8Link::PausedJob): a job runs on the link's serial thread over the port the link already holds,
// what was pushed before the pause is delivered first, a push during it is dropped and counted, and the job completes
// once streaming has resumed, on the same port and with the reliable link's sequence state intact. A ROM upload boots
// through the cart's menu and stops streaming, as the SD worker's load does; the battery jobs read and write the
// battery file the N8 OS keeps on the SD card, at the menu only, and never the cart's own battery.
//
// The fake device below is a model of the cart's USB side, enough for these: it parses Edio's command frames as they
// are written (status, memory reads and writes, the SD directory and file API, with a failure it can inject into a
// directory load, a file write or a file read), counts the files open on the card, keeps a 64 KB battery (logged if
// anything touches it) and the FPGA config block (map_idx 255 while the menu shows), answers the menu's '*' commands
// while the menu is showing, and plays BlipToaster's end of the reliable link while a game that speaks it runs. Every
// event (a FIFO write, a battery read, a file block) lands in one ordered log.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdint>
#include <deque>
#include <filesystem>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

#include "host/engine/CapabilityJobs.hpp"
#include "host/n8/Edio.hpp"
#include "host/n8/N8CartLink.hpp"
#include "host/n8/N8Host.hpp"

using retroplug::Edio;
using retroplug::ISerialPort;
using retroplug::N8CartLink;
using retroplug::N8Host;
using retroplug::N8Link;
using retroplug::N8PortDto;
using rp::host::Job;
using rp::host::JobRequest;
using Bytes = std::vector<std::uint8_t>;

namespace {

// The cart: what every port opened on it shares, under one lock (the serial thread drives it while the test reads).
struct FakeN8 {
    std::mutex               mu;
    Bytes                    sram = Bytes(Edio::SIZE_SRM_GAME, 0);
    Bytes                    cfg  = Bytes(Edio::SIZE_CFG, 0);
    std::map<std::string, Bytes> files;
    bool                     menu = true;           // the file browser is showing (it answers '*' commands)
    bool                     linkRom = false;       // the running game answers the reliable link (BlipToaster)
    bool                     linkDeaf = false;      // ... until it stops answering (it read no frame and acks nothing)
    int                      fileDelayMs = 0;       // likewise each SD file write
    int                      fileReadDelayMs = 0;   // likewise each SD file read block
    bool                     failNextWrite = false; // the next SD file write answers its first block with an error
    bool                     failNextRead = false;  // the next SD file read block answers an error
    bool                     failNextList = false;  // the next directory load answers a disk error
    int                      filesOpen = 0;         // files opened on the card and not yet closed
    std::uint16_t            mapIndex = 69;         // what '*n' answers
    std::string              booted;                // the path '*s' started
    // "fifo:90 3C 7F", "srm-rd", "srm-wr", "file-wr", "file-rd", ..., in order
    std::vector<std::string> log;
    std::vector<Bytes>       applied;               // messages the reliable link delivered to the game
    int                      syncs = 0;             // F4 syncs the game saw
    std::vector<int>         frameSeqs;             // the seq of every intact frame it read
    int                      opens = 0, openNow = 0;

    std::size_t count(const std::string& prefix) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(mu);
        return static_cast<std::size_t>(
            std::count_if(log.begin(), log.end(), [&](const std::string& e) { return e.rfind(prefix, 0) == 0; }));
    }
};

std::string hex(const std::uint8_t* d, std::size_t n) {
    static const char* digits = "0123456789ABCDEF";
    std::string s;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (i) s += ' ';
        s += digits[d[i] >> 4];
        s += digits[d[i] & 15];
    }
    return s;
}

// One open port on the cart: Edio's frames parsed as they arrive, the replies queued for the host's reads.
struct FakeN8Port : ISerialPort {
    explicit FakeN8Port(FakeN8& dev) : dev_(dev) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(dev_.mu);
        ++dev_.opens;
        ++dev_.openNow;
    }
    ~FakeN8Port() override {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(dev_.mu);
        --dev_.openNow;
    }
    std::size_t write(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t n) override {
        int delayMs = 0;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(dev_.mu);
            in_.insert(in_.end(), data, data + n);
            delayMs = parse();
        }
        if (delayMs) std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(delayMs));
        return n;
    }
    std::size_t read(std::uint8_t* b, std::size_t n, int) override {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(dev_.mu);
        std::size_t i = 0;
        while (i < n && !out_.empty()) {
            b[i++] = out_.front();
            out_.pop_front();
        }
        return i;
    }
    void flushInput() override {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(dev_.mu);
        out_.clear();
    }

private:
    static std::uint32_t le32(const Bytes& b, std::size_t at) {
        return b[at] | (b[at + 1] << 8) | (b[at + 2] << 16) | (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(b[at + 3]) << 24);
    }
    void reply(std::initializer_list<std::uint8_t> bytes) { out_.insert(out_.end(), bytes); }

    // Consume every complete command in in_; the delay a battery read asks for, applied outside the lock.
    int parse() {
        int delay = 0;
        for (;;) {
            if (fileLeft_ > 0) {  // the data of a file write, a 1 KB block after each ack
                const std::size_t take = std::min<std::size_t>({in_.size(), fileLeft_, blockLeft_});
                if (take == 0) return delay;
                file_.insert(file_.end(), in_.begin(), in_.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(take));
                in_.erase(in_.begin(), in_.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(take));
                fileLeft_ -= take;
                blockLeft_ -= take;
                if (blockLeft_ == 0 && fileLeft_ > 0) {
                    blockLeft_ = Edio::ACK_BLOCK_SIZE;
                    reply({0});
                }
                if (fileLeft_ == 0) {
                    Bytes& f = dev_.files[filePath_];
                    f.insert(f.end(), file_.begin(), file_.end());
                }
                continue;
            }
            if (in_.size() < 4) return delay;
            const std::uint8_t cmd = in_[2];
            std::size_t need = 4;
            if (cmd == Edio::CMD_MEM_RD) need = 13;
            if (cmd == Edio::CMD_MEM_WR) need = in_.size() >= 13 ? 13 + le32(in_, 8) : 13;
            if (cmd == Edio::CMD_F_FOPN) need = in_.size() >= 7 ? 7 + (in_[5] | (in_[6] << 8)) : 7;
            if (cmd == Edio::CMD_F_FWR) need = 8;
            if (cmd == Edio::CMD_F_DEL) need = in_.size() >= 6 ? 6 + (in_[4] | (in_[5] << 8)) : 6;
            if (cmd == Edio::CMD_F_DIR_LD) need = in_.size() >= 7 ? 7 + (in_[5] | (in_[6] << 8)) : 7;
            if (cmd == Edio::CMD_F_DIR_GET) need = 10;
            if (cmd == Edio::CMD_F_FRD) need = 8;
            if (in_.size() < need) return delay;
            const Bytes c(in_.begin(), in_.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(need));
            in_.erase(in_.begin(), in_.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(need));
            if (cmd == Edio::CMD_STATUS) {
                reply({status_, 0xA5});
                status_ = 0;
            } else if (cmd == Edio::CMD_F_DIR_LD) {
                const std::string dir = std::string(c.begin() + 7, c.end()) + "/";
                dirList_.clear();
                for (const auto& [path, bytes] : dev_.files)
                    if (path.rfind(dir, 0) == 0 && path.find('/', dir.size()) == std::string::npos)
                        dirList_.push_back({path.substr(dir.size()), bytes.size()});
                if (dirList_.empty()) status_ = 0x05;  // FR_NO_PATH
                if (dev_.failNextList) {
                    dev_.failNextList = false;
                    dirList_.clear();
                    status_ = 0x01;  // FR_DISK_ERR
                }
            } else if (cmd == Edio::CMD_F_DIR_SIZE) {
                const auto n = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(dirList_.size());
                reply({static_cast<std::uint8_t>(n), static_cast<std::uint8_t>(n >> 8)});
            } else if (cmd == Edio::CMD_F_DIR_GET) {
                for (const auto& [name, size] : dirList_) {
                    const auto s = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(size);
                    reply({0, static_cast<std::uint8_t>(s), static_cast<std::uint8_t>(s >> 8),
                           static_cast<std::uint8_t>(s >> 16), static_cast<std::uint8_t>(s >> 24), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0,
                           static_cast<std::uint8_t>(name.size()), static_cast<std::uint8_t>(name.size() >> 8)});
                    out_.insert(out_.end(), name.begin(), name.end());
                }
            } else if (cmd == Edio::CMD_F_FRD && dev_.failNextRead) {
                dev_.failNextRead = false;
                reply({0x01});  // FR_DISK_ERR: no data follows
                dev_.log.push_back("file-rd-fail");
            } else if (cmd == Edio::CMD_F_FRD) {
                const std::uint32_t block = le32(c, 4);
                const Bytes& file = dev_.files[filePath_];
                reply({0});
                for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < block; ++i)
                    out_.push_back(readPos_ + i < file.size() ? file[readPos_ + i] : 0);
                readPos_ += block;
                dev_.log.push_back("file-rd");
                delay = dev_.fileReadDelayMs;
            } else if (cmd == Edio::CMD_MEM_RD) {
                const std::uint32_t addr = le32(c, 4), size = le32(c, 8);
                for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) out_.push_back(peek(addr + i));
                if (addr >= Edio::ADDR_SRM && addr < Edio::ADDR_SRM + Edio::SIZE_SRM_GAME) dev_.log.push_back("srm-rd");
            } else if (cmd == Edio::CMD_MEM_WR) {
                const std::uint32_t addr = le32(c, 4), size = le32(c, 8);
                const std::uint8_t* data = c.data() + 13;
                if (addr == static_cast<std::uint32_t>(Edio::ADDR_FIFO)) {
                    dev_.log.push_back("fifo:" + hex(data, size));
                    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) fifoByte(data[i]);
                } else {
                    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) poke(addr + i, data[i]);
                    if (addr >= Edio::ADDR_SRM && addr < Edio::ADDR_SRM + Edio::SIZE_SRM_GAME)
                        dev_.log.push_back("srm-wr");
                }
            } else if (cmd == Edio::CMD_F_DEL) {
                const std::string path(c.begin() + 6, c.end());
                dev_.files.erase(path);
                dev_.log.push_back("file-del:" + path);
            } else if (cmd == Edio::CMD_F_FOPN) {
                filePath_ = std::string(c.begin() + 7, c.end());
                readPos_ = 0;
                if (c[4] & Edio::FA_WRITE) dev_.files[filePath_].clear();
                else if (!dev_.files.count(filePath_)) status_ = 0x04;  // FR_NO_FILE
                if (status_ == 0) ++dev_.filesOpen;
            } else if (cmd == Edio::CMD_F_FCLOSE) {
                if (dev_.filesOpen > 0) --dev_.filesOpen;
            } else if (cmd == Edio::CMD_F_FWR) {
                dev_.log.push_back("file-wr");
                delay = dev_.fileDelayMs;
                fileLeft_ = le32(c, 4);
                blockLeft_ = Edio::ACK_BLOCK_SIZE;
                file_.clear();
                if (dev_.failNextWrite && fileLeft_ > 0) {  // the block is refused: no data follows
                    dev_.failNextWrite = false;
                    fileLeft_ = 0;
                    reply({0x01});
                } else if (fileLeft_ > 0) {
                    reply({0});
                }
            }
        }
    }
    std::uint8_t peek(std::uint32_t addr) {
        if (addr >= Edio::ADDR_SRM && addr < Edio::ADDR_SRM + Edio::SIZE_SRM_GAME)
            return static_cast<std::uint8_t>(dev_.sram[addr - Edio::ADDR_SRM]);
        // The menu runs on the OS's own mapper, 255.
        if (dev_.menu && addr == static_cast<std::uint32_t>(Edio::ADDR_CFG)) return 0xFF;
        if (dev_.menu && addr == static_cast<std::uint32_t>(Edio::ADDR_CFG) + 2) return 0;
        if (addr >= Edio::ADDR_CFG && addr < Edio::ADDR_CFG + Edio::SIZE_CFG) return dev_.cfg[addr - Edio::ADDR_CFG];
        return 0;
    }
    void poke(std::uint32_t addr, std::uint8_t v) {
        if (addr >= Edio::ADDR_SRM && addr < Edio::ADDR_SRM + Edio::SIZE_SRM_GAME) dev_.sram[addr - Edio::ADDR_SRM] = v;
        if (addr >= Edio::ADDR_CFG && addr < Edio::ADDR_CFG + Edio::SIZE_CFG) dev_.cfg[addr - Edio::ADDR_CFG] = v;
    }

    // What the cart's side of the FIFO makes of a byte: the menu's commands, or the game's reliable link.
    void fifoByte(std::uint8_t b) {
        if (dev_.menu) {
            menu_.push_back(b);
            if (menu_[0] != '*') { menu_.clear(); return; }      // not a command: the menu skips it
            if (menu_.size() < 2) return;
            if (menu_[1] == 't') { reply({'k'}); menu_.clear(); return; }
            if (menu_[1] == 's') {  // the game boots, and the FPGA's config block names its mapper
                dev_.menu = false;
                dev_.booted = menuPath_;
                dev_.cfg[0] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(dev_.mapIndex);
                dev_.cfg[2] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>((dev_.mapIndex >> 8) << 4);
                menu_.clear();
                return;
            }
            if (menu_[1] == 'n') {                                // '*n', then a length-prefixed path
                if (menu_.size() < 4) return;
                const std::size_t len = menu_[2] | (menu_[3] << 8);
                if (menu_.size() < 4 + len) return;
                menuPath_ = std::string(menu_.begin() + 4, menu_.end());
                reply({0x00, static_cast<std::uint8_t>(dev_.mapIndex), static_cast<std::uint8_t>(dev_.mapIndex >> 8)});
                menu_.clear();
                return;
            }
            menu_.clear();
            return;
        }
        if (!dev_.linkRom || dev_.linkDeaf) return;
        // BlipToaster's end of the link, for intact traffic: a sync sets the next seq, a frame carrying it is applied,
        // and each is acknowledged with F5 <next expected> <last header read>.
        switch (link_) {
            case Idle:
                if (b == 0xF4) link_ = WantSync;
                else if (b == 0xF5) link_ = WantSeq;
                return;
            case WantSync:
                next_ = b;
                ++dev_.syncs;
                reply({0xF5, next_, static_cast<std::uint8_t>((next_ - 1) & 0x7F)});
                link_ = Idle;
                return;
            case WantSeq:
                seq_ = b;
                msg_.clear();
                link_ = InMsg;
                return;
            case InMsg: {
                msg_.push_back(b);
                const std::size_t len = (msg_[0] & 0xE0) == 0xC0 ? 2 : 3;
                if (msg_.size() == len) link_ = WantSum;
                return;
            }
            case WantSum: {
                unsigned sum = seq_;
                for (auto m : msg_) sum += m;
                link_ = Idle;
                if (b != (sum & 0x7F)) return;
                dev_.frameSeqs.push_back(seq_);
                if (seq_ == next_) {
                    dev_.applied.push_back(msg_);
                    next_ = static_cast<std::uint8_t>((next_ + 1) & 0x7F);
                }
                reply({0xF5, next_, seq_});
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    FakeN8&                  dev_;
    Bytes                    in_;
    std::deque<std::uint8_t> out_;
    std::string              filePath_;
    std::size_t              readPos_ = 0;
    std::uint8_t             status_ = 0;  // what the next CMD_STATUS answers (a FatFs error, or 0)
    std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::size_t>> dirList_;
    Bytes                    file_;
    std::size_t              fileLeft_ = 0, blockLeft_ = 0;
    Bytes                    menu_;
    std::string              menuPath_;
    enum { Idle, WantSync, WantSeq, InMsg, WantSum } link_ = Idle;
    std::uint8_t             next_ = 0, seq_ = 0;
    Bytes                    msg_;
};

N8Link::PortFactory factoryFor(FakeN8& dev) {
    return [&dev](const std::string&) -> std::unique_ptr<ISerialPort> { return std::make_unique<FakeN8Port>(dev); };
}

std::string tempDir() {
    const auto dir = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "rp-n8-cartjobs-test";
    std::filesystem::create_directories(dir);
    std::filesystem::remove(dir / "n8.cfg");
    return dir.string();
}

template <class Pred>
bool waitUntil(Pred pred, int ms = 3000) {
    for (int i = 0; i < ms && !pred(); ++i) std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1));
    return pred();
}

JobRequest request(const char* capability, const char* op) {
    JobRequest r;
    r.nodeId     = "cart";
    r.capability = capability;
    r.op         = op;
    return r;
}

// A connected host on the fake cart, streaming with no lookahead. `link` false skips the reliable link's probe.
struct Rig {
    FakeN8     dev;
    N8Host     host{factoryFor(dev), [] { return std::vector<N8PortDto>{{"/dev/fake", true}}; }, tempDir()};
    N8CartLink cart{host};
    int        owner = 0;  // the address that stands for the node submitting
    // Every case ends with no file left open on the card, whatever its jobs did.
    ~Rig() {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(dev.mu);
        CHECK(dev.filesOpen == 0);
    }

    void connect() {
        host.setPort("/dev/fake");
        host.connect(true);
        REQUIRE(host.link().isConnected());
        host.link().setLookaheadMs(0);
    }
    bool submit(const JobRequest& r, Job& job, std::string* error = nullptr) {
        std::string why;
        const bool ok = cart.submitJob(r, job, &owner, &why);
        if (error) *error = why;
        return ok;
    }
    void push(std::initializer_list<std::uint8_t> bytes) {
        const Bytes b(bytes);
        cart.push(0, b.data(), b.size(), false, 48000.0);
    }
};

}  // namespace

namespace {

// The battery file the N8 OS keeps for game.nes, and a save to put there.
const char* const kGameBattery = "EDN8/gamedata/game.nes/bram.srm";
Bytes saveOf(std::size_t n, unsigned seed) {
    Bytes b(n);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) b[i] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i * seed + 1);
    return b;
}
JobRequest battery(const char* op, const char* rom = "game.nes") {
    auto r = request(RP_SYSTEM_SRAM_INTERFACE, op);
    r.name = rom;
    return r;
}

// An iNES image of mapper 69 (Sunsoft 5B, a cart with its own sound chip), `kb` KB of PRG behind its header.
Bytes inesImage(std::size_t kb) {
    Bytes rom = {'N', 'E', 'S', 0x1A, 16, 4, 0x50, 0x40};
    rom.resize(16 + kb * 1024, 0xEA);
    return rom;
}

JobRequest uploadOf(const Bytes& rom) {
    auto r = request(RP_SYSTEM_ROM_INTERFACE, "upload");
    r.bytes = rom;
    r.name = "game.nes";
    return r;
}

}  // namespace

TEST_CASE("a dump job pauses streaming on the port it has, delivers what was pushed first, reads the battery file "
          "with progress, and resumes before it completes", "[n8][cart-jobs]") {
    Rig rig;
    const Bytes save = saveOf(3000, 7);
    rig.dev.files[kGameBattery] = save;
    rig.dev.fileReadDelayMs = 20;
    rig.connect();

    // A note pushed 20 ms ahead and then a job at once: the note goes out at its own time, before the first read.
    rig.host.link().setLookaheadMs(20);
    rig.push({0x90, 0x3C, 0x7F});
    rig.push({0x80, 0x3C, 0x00});
    rig.host.link().setLookaheadMs(0);
    Job job;
    REQUIRE(rig.submit(battery("dump"), job));
    REQUIRE(rig.host.cartJobBusy());

    // While it runs: the link reads disconnected, and a push goes nowhere and is counted.
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return rig.dev.count("file-rd") > 0; }));
    CHECK_FALSE(rig.cart.connected());
    rig.push({0x90, 0x40, 0x7F});
    CHECK(rig.cart.dropped() == 1);

    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return job.finished(); }));
    CHECK(job.state.load() == Job::Done);
    CHECK(job.result == save);
    CHECK(job.total.load() == save.size());     // a block a step, in bytes
    CHECK(job.progress.load() == save.size());
    // Completed after streaming resumed, on the one port the link opened.
    CHECK(rig.cart.connected());
    CHECK_FALSE(rig.host.cartJobBusy());
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(rig.dev.mu);
        CHECK(rig.dev.opens == 1);
        const auto at = [&](const std::string& e) {
            return std::find(rig.dev.log.begin(), rig.dev.log.end(), e) - rig.dev.log.begin();
        };
        const auto end = static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(rig.dev.log.size());
        CHECK(at("fifo:90 3C 7F") < end);
        CHECK(at("fifo:90 3C 7F") < at("fifo:80 3C 00"));
        CHECK(at("fifo:80 3C 00") < at("file-rd"));
    }
    CHECK(rig.dev.count("file-rd") == (save.size() + 511) / 512);  // one 512-byte block a step
    CHECK(rig.dev.count("srm-") == 0);                              // the cart's own battery: never
    CHECK(rig.dev.count("fifo:90 40") == 0);  // the push the pause dropped never reached the cart

    rig.push({0x91, 0x41, 0x7F});
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return rig.dev.count("fifo:91 41 7F") == 1; }));
}

TEST_CASE("a restore job writes the battery file, creating the folder, for the game's next boot", "[n8][cart-jobs]") {
    Rig rig;
    rig.connect();
    const Bytes save = saveOf(8192 + 100, 13);
    auto r = battery("restore", "fresh.nes");
    r.bytes = save;
    Job job;
    REQUIRE(rig.submit(r, job));
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return job.finished(); }));
    CHECK(job.state.load() == Job::Done);
    CHECK(std::string(job.result.begin(), job.result.end()) ==
          R"({"path":"EDN8/gamedata/fresh.nes/bram.srm","created":true})");
    CHECK(job.total.load() == save.size());
    CHECK(job.progress.load() == save.size());
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(rig.dev.mu);
        CHECK(rig.dev.files["EDN8/gamedata/fresh.nes/bram.srm"] == save);
    }
    CHECK(rig.dev.count("srm-") == 0);
    CHECK(rig.cart.connected());

    // A dump reads back what the restore wrote.
    Job back;
    REQUIRE(rig.submit(battery("dump", "fresh.nes"), back));
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return back.finished(); }));
    CHECK(back.result == save);

    // Arguments refused at submission, the record untouched.
    Job none;
    std::string why;
    auto empty = battery("restore");
    CHECK_FALSE(rig.submit(empty, none, &why));
    CHECK(why == "a battery restore takes 1 to 1048576 bytes");
    auto bad = battery("dump", "../x.nes");
    CHECK_FALSE(rig.submit(bad, none, &why));
    CHECK(why == "a battery job names the ROM's file, a plain file name");
    CHECK_FALSE(rig.submit(request(RP_SYSTEM_SRAM_INTERFACE, "dump"), none, &why));
    CHECK(why == "a battery job needs the ROM's file name: name it, or boot the ROM through rom.upload first");
    CHECK(none.state.load() == Job::Queued);
}

TEST_CASE("battery jobs refuse a running game, and a dump finds no file a game never saved", "[n8][cart-jobs]") {
    Rig rig;
    rig.dev.menu = false;  // a game runs
    rig.dev.files[kGameBattery] = saveOf(512, 3);
    rig.connect();
    for (const char* op : {"dump", "restore"}) {
        auto r = battery(op);
        r.bytes = Bytes(16, 1);
        Job job;
        REQUIRE(rig.submit(r, job));
        REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return job.finished() && !rig.host.cartJobBusy(); }));
        CHECK(job.state.load() == Job::Failed);
        CHECK(job.error == "the battery file can only be reached at the N8 menu: power-cycle to the menu first");
    }
    CHECK(rig.dev.count("file-") == 0);
    CHECK(rig.dev.count("srm-") == 0);
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(rig.dev.mu);
        CHECK(rig.dev.files[kGameBattery] == saveOf(512, 3));  // untouched
        rig.dev.menu = true;
    }
    Job missing;
    REQUIRE(rig.submit(battery("dump", "never.nes"), missing));
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return missing.finished(); }));
    CHECK(missing.state.load() == Job::Failed);
    CHECK(missing.error == "no battery file for never.nes (EDN8/gamedata/never.nes/bram.srm)");
    CHECK(rig.cart.connected());
}

TEST_CASE("one cart job at a time, none while disconnected, and an operation the cart does not have is refused",
          "[n8][cart-jobs]") {
    Rig rig;
    rig.dev.files[kGameBattery] = saveOf(2048, 5);
    rig.dev.fileReadDelayMs = 50;
    std::string why;
    Job early;
    CHECK_FALSE(rig.submit(battery("dump"), early, &why));
    CHECK(why == "not connected");

    rig.connect();
    Job job, second;
    REQUIRE(rig.submit(battery("dump"), job));
    CHECK_FALSE(rig.submit(battery("dump"), second, &why));
    CHECK(why == "busy: the cart is running another job");
    // The host's own config writes wait for the job too: a port switch or a disconnect would pull the port from under
    // it.
    rig.host.connect(false);
    CHECK(rig.host.getConfig().enabled);
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return job.finished() && !rig.host.cartJobBusy(); }));

    CHECK_FALSE(rig.submit(request(RP_SYSTEM_MEMORY_INTERFACE, "read"), second, &why));
    CHECK(why == "the cart presents no rp.system.memory/1");
    CHECK_FALSE(rig.submit(request(RP_SYSTEM_SRAM_INTERFACE, "erase"), second, &why));
    CHECK(why == "rp.system.sram/1 has no operation 'erase'");
    CHECK_FALSE(rig.submit(request(RP_SYSTEM_ROM_INTERFACE, "header"), second, &why));
    CHECK(why == "nothing this host booted is running");
}

TEST_CASE("a ROM upload boots through the menu, stops streaming and clears the enabled toggle, and says so",
          "[n8][cart-jobs]") {
    Rig rig;
    rig.connect();  // at the menu: the link streams to it, which skips what is not a command
    REQUIRE(rig.host.getConfig().enabled);
    Bytes rom = {'N', 'E', 'S', 0x1A, 16, 4, 0x50, 0x40};  // mapper 69 (Sunsoft 5B): a cart with its own sound chip
    rom.resize(16 + 20000, 0xEA);

    auto r = request(RP_SYSTEM_ROM_INTERFACE, "upload");
    r.bytes = rom;
    r.name  = "game.nes";
    Job job;
    REQUIRE(rig.submit(r, job));
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return job.finished(); }));
    REQUIRE(job.state.load() == Job::Done);
    CHECK(std::string(job.result.begin(), job.result.end()) ==
          R"({"path":"usb-games/game.nes","mapIndex":69,"streaming":"stopped"})");
    CHECK(job.progress.load() == rom.size());

    // The game runs, streaming stopped (the port given back), the toggle cleared, the expansion volume at unity for a
    // mapper with expansion audio (the host's default is AUTO).
    CHECK_FALSE(rig.cart.connected());
    CHECK_FALSE(rig.host.getConfig().enabled);
    CHECK_FALSE(rig.host.cartJobBusy());
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(rig.dev.mu);
        CHECK(rig.dev.files["usb-games/game.nes"] == rom);
        CHECK(rig.dev.booted == "usb-games/game.nes");
        CHECK_FALSE(rig.dev.menu);
        CHECK(rig.dev.cfg[3] == N8Host::EXP_VOL_UNITY);
        CHECK(rig.dev.openNow == 0);
    }

    // What it booted answers at once, with no transfer and the link down.
    auto header = request(RP_SYSTEM_ROM_INTERFACE, "header");
    header.length = 16;
    Job h, t;
    REQUIRE(rig.submit(header, h));
    CHECK(h.state.load() == Job::Done);
    CHECK(h.result == Bytes(rom.begin(), rom.begin() + 16));
    REQUIRE(rig.submit(request(RP_SYSTEM_ROM_INTERFACE, "title"), t));
    CHECK(std::string(t.result.begin(), t.result.end()) == "game.nes");

    // Reconnecting reaches the new game.
    rig.host.connect(true);
    REQUIRE(rig.cart.connected());
    // Still the game this host booted: what it booted still answers after the reconnect.
    Job kept;
    REQUIRE(rig.submit(header, kept));
    CHECK(kept.result == Bytes(rom.begin(), rom.begin() + 16));

    // An upload with no menu to load it fails before a byte reaches the game's FIFO, and leaves the cart streaming.
    const std::size_t menuCommands = rig.dev.count("fifo:2A");  // the first upload's *t, *n and *s
    Job again;
    REQUIRE(rig.submit(r, again));
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return again.finished(); }));
    CHECK(again.state.load() == Job::Failed);
    CHECK(again.error.rfind("the cart is running a game", 0) == 0);
    CHECK(rig.dev.count("fifo:2A") == menuCommands);
    CHECK(rig.cart.connected());
    CHECK(rig.host.getConfig().enabled);

    std::string why;
    auto unnamed = r;
    unnamed.name = "../x.nes";
    CHECK_FALSE(rig.submit(unnamed, again, &why));
    CHECK(why == "an upload names the file it is stored under, a plain file name");
}

TEST_CASE("the reliable link keeps its sequence across a pause: no new sync, the next frame carries the next seq",
          "[n8][cart-jobs]") {
    Rig rig;
    rig.dev.menu = false;
    rig.dev.linkRom = true;  // BlipToaster, which answers the probe
    rig.connect();
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return rig.host.link().reliable(); }));

    rig.push({0x90, 0x3C, 0x7F});
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return rig.dev.count("fifo:F4") + rig.dev.count("fifo:F5") >= 2; }));
    // Every job pauses the stream before it looks at the cart: this one then finds a game running and fails, which
    // is all the pause needs to have happened.
    Job job;
    REQUIRE(rig.submit(battery("dump"), job));
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return job.finished(); }));
    REQUIRE(job.state.load() == Job::Failed);
    REQUIRE(rig.cart.connected());
    rig.push({0x80, 0x3C, 0x00});
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(rig.dev.mu);
        return rig.dev.applied.size() == 2;
    }));
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(rig.dev.mu);
    CHECK(rig.dev.applied[0] == Bytes{0x90, 0x3C, 0x7F});
    CHECK(rig.dev.applied[1] == Bytes{0x80, 0x3C, 0x00});
    // The probe's sync and the first frame's: none after the pause, whose frame simply carries seq 1.
    CHECK(rig.dev.syncs == 2);
    CHECK(rig.dev.frameSeqs == std::vector<int>{0, 1});
    CHECK(rig.dev.opens == 1);
    CHECK(rig.host.link().reliable());
}

TEST_CASE("a job its node abandons fails at once, stops at its next chunk, and the cart resumes streaming",
          "[n8][cart-jobs]") {
    Rig rig;
    rig.dev.fileDelayMs = 20;
    rig.dev.files[kGameBattery] = saveOf(4096, 9);
    rig.connect();
    Job job;
    REQUIRE(rig.submit(uploadOf(inesImage(64)), job));  // eight 8 KB chunks
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return rig.dev.count("file-wr") >= 2; }));
    rig.cart.abandonJobs(&rig.owner);
    CHECK(job.state.load() == Job::Failed);
    CHECK(job.failure.load() == Job::Removed);
    const std::uint32_t progressAtAbandon = job.progress.load();

    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return !rig.host.cartJobBusy(); }));
    CHECK(rig.cart.connected());                      // nothing booted: streaming resumed to the menu, as it was
    CHECK(rig.dev.count("file-wr") < 8);              // it stopped early
    CHECK(job.progress.load() == progressAtAbandon);  // and reported nothing more into the record
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(rig.dev.mu);
        CHECK(rig.dev.menu);
        CHECK(rig.dev.booted.empty());
        CHECK(rig.dev.files.count("usb-games/game.nes") == 0);  // the partial image went with the job
    }

    // A dump abandoned between its blocks stops there, having changed nothing.
    rig.dev.fileReadDelayMs = 20;
    Job dump;
    REQUIRE(rig.submit(battery("dump"), dump));
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return rig.dev.count("file-rd") >= 2; }));
    rig.cart.abandonJobs(&rig.owner);
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return !rig.host.cartJobBusy(); }));
    CHECK(dump.failure.load() == Job::Removed);
    CHECK(rig.dev.count("file-rd") < 8);
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(rig.dev.mu);
        CHECK(rig.dev.files[kGameBattery] == saveOf(4096, 9));
    }

    // Another node's abandon is not this job's: a second job runs to its end.
    Job next;
    REQUIRE(rig.submit(battery("dump"), next));
    int other = 0;
    rig.cart.abandonJobs(&other);
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return next.finished(); }));
    CHECK(next.state.load() == Job::Done);
}

TEST_CASE("an upload abandoned after its last chunk still boots nothing, and its file goes", "[n8][cart-jobs]") {
    Rig rig;
    rig.dev.fileDelayMs = 150;
    rig.connect();
    Job job;
    // One chunk: the abandon lands during its write, after the loop's last check.
    REQUIRE(rig.submit(uploadOf(inesImage(4)), job));
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return rig.dev.count("file-wr") >= 1; }));
    rig.cart.abandonJobs(&rig.owner);
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return !rig.host.cartJobBusy(); }));
    CHECK(job.failure.load() == Job::Removed);
    CHECK(rig.cart.connected());
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(rig.dev.mu);
    CHECK(rig.dev.menu);
    CHECK(rig.dev.booted.empty());
    CHECK(rig.dev.files.count("usb-games/game.nes") == 0);
}

TEST_CASE("a disconnect during a job ends it with the reason, and a job taken just before one still completes",
          "[n8][cart-jobs]") {
    Rig rig;
    rig.dev.fileDelayMs = 20;
    rig.connect();
    Job job;
    REQUIRE(rig.submit(uploadOf(inesImage(64)), job));
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return rig.dev.count("file-wr") >= 1; }));
    rig.host.link().disconnect();  // joins: the job stops at its next chunk
    REQUIRE(job.finished());
    CHECK(job.state.load() == Job::Failed);
    CHECK(job.error == "the link was disconnected during the job");
    CHECK_FALSE(rig.host.cartJobBusy());

    // Taken and then the link torn down before the serial thread could run it: it fails, never hangs.
    rig.connect();
    Job raced;
    REQUIRE(rig.submit(battery("dump"), raced));
    rig.host.link().disconnect();
    REQUIRE(raced.finished());
    CHECK_FALSE(rig.host.cartJobBusy());
}

TEST_CASE("a connect forgets what this host booted once the cart runs something else, and the battery jobs default "
          "to the ROM it last booted", "[n8][cart-jobs]") {
    Rig rig;
    rig.connect();
    Job up;
    REQUIRE(rig.submit(uploadOf(inesImage(8)), up));
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return up.finished(); }));
    REQUIRE(up.state.load() == Job::Done);
    Job before;
    REQUIRE(rig.submit(request(RP_SYSTEM_ROM_INTERFACE, "title"), before));

    // A power-cycle: the cart is back at its menu, whose map_idx the next connect reads; the OS wrote the game's
    // battery back to its file on the way.
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(rig.dev.mu);
        rig.dev.menu = true;
        rig.dev.files[kGameBattery] = saveOf(1024, 11);
    }
    rig.host.connect(true);
    REQUIRE(rig.cart.connected());
    Job after;
    std::string why;
    CHECK_FALSE(rig.submit(request(RP_SYSTEM_ROM_INTERFACE, "header"), after, &why));
    CHECK(why == "nothing this host booted is running");

    // The battery file of what it booted, with no name given.
    Job dump;
    REQUIRE(rig.submit(request(RP_SYSTEM_SRAM_INTERFACE, "dump"), dump));
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return dump.finished(); }));
    CHECK(dump.state.load() == Job::Done);
    CHECK(dump.result == saveOf(1024, 11));
}

TEST_CASE("the pause waits a bounded time for acks a silent cart never sends, and a disconnect inside that wait "
          "returns promptly", "[n8][cart-jobs]") {
    using Clock = std::chrono::steady_clock;
    const auto ms = [](Clock::time_point t) {
        return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(Clock::now() - t).count();
    };
    SECTION("the bound") {
        Rig rig;
        rig.dev.menu = false;
        rig.dev.linkRom = true;
        rig.connect();
        REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return rig.host.link().reliable(); }));
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(rig.dev.mu);
            rig.dev.linkDeaf = true;
        }
        rig.push({0x90, 0x3C, 0x7F});  // a frame the cart never acknowledges
        REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return rig.host.link().linkOutstanding() == 1; }));
        Job job;
        const auto t0 = Clock::now();
        REQUIRE(rig.submit(battery("dump"), job));
        REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return job.finished(); }));
        const auto took = ms(t0);
        CHECK(took >= 250);  // it waited for the ack...
        CHECK(took < 2000);  // ...a bounded time, then ran the job (which found a game running)
        CHECK(job.error == "the battery file can only be reached at the N8 menu: power-cycle to the menu first");
    }
    SECTION("a disconnect inside the wait") {
        Rig rig;
        rig.dev.menu = false;
        rig.dev.linkRom = true;
        rig.connect();
        REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return rig.host.link().reliable(); }));
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(rig.dev.mu);
            rig.dev.linkDeaf = true;
        }
        rig.push({0x90, 0x3C, 0x7F});
        REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return rig.host.link().linkOutstanding() == 1; }));
        Job job;
        REQUIRE(rig.submit(battery("dump"), job));
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(60));  // inside the 250 ms the drain waits for acks
        const auto t0 = Clock::now();
        rig.host.link().disconnect();
        CHECK(ms(t0) < 200);
        REQUIRE(job.finished());
        CHECK(job.error == "the link went down before the job ran");
        CHECK_FALSE(rig.host.cartJobBusy());
    }
}

TEST_CASE("a restore whose write fails says the battery file is replaced and incomplete, and closes it; a failed read "
          "closes too", "[n8][cart-jobs]") {
    Rig rig;
    rig.dev.files[kGameBattery] = saveOf(2048, 3);
    rig.connect();
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(rig.dev.mu);
        rig.dev.failNextWrite = true;
    }
    auto r = battery("restore");
    r.bytes = saveOf(4096, 5);
    Job job;
    REQUIRE(rig.submit(r, job));
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return job.finished() && !rig.host.cartJobBusy(); }));
    CHECK(job.state.load() == Job::Failed);
    CHECK(job.error.rfind("the battery file EDN8/gamedata/game.nes/bram.srm was replaced and is incomplete: restore "
                          "again (", 0) == 0);
    CHECK(rig.cart.connected());
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(rig.dev.mu);
        CHECK(rig.dev.filesOpen == 0);                 // closed on the failure path
        CHECK(rig.dev.files[kGameBattery].empty());    // the open emptied the old save: neither save is there
        rig.dev.files[kGameBattery] = saveOf(2048, 3);
        rig.dev.failNextRead = true;
    }
    Job dump;
    REQUIRE(rig.submit(battery("dump"), dump));
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return dump.finished() && !rig.host.cartJobBusy(); }));
    CHECK(dump.state.load() == Job::Failed);
    CHECK(dump.error == "Edio: file read error 0x01");
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(rig.dev.mu);
    CHECK(rig.dev.filesOpen == 0);
}

TEST_CASE("a restore replaces a longer file whole and says whether it made the ROM's folder", "[n8][cart-jobs]") {
    Rig rig;
    rig.dev.files[kGameBattery] = saveOf(8192, 3);
    rig.connect();
    auto r = battery("restore");
    r.bytes = saveOf(1000, 5);
    Job over;
    REQUIRE(rig.submit(r, over));
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return over.finished() && !rig.host.cartJobBusy(); }));
    REQUIRE(over.state.load() == Job::Done);
    CHECK(std::string(over.result.begin(), over.result.end()) ==
          R"({"path":"EDN8/gamedata/game.nes/bram.srm","created":false})");
    auto fresh = battery("restore", "fresh.nes");
    fresh.bytes = saveOf(16, 1);
    Job made;
    REQUIRE(rig.submit(fresh, made));
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return made.finished() && !rig.host.cartJobBusy(); }));
    CHECK(std::string(made.result.begin(), made.result.end()) ==
          R"({"path":"EDN8/gamedata/fresh.nes/bram.srm","created":true})");
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(rig.dev.mu);
    CHECK(rig.dev.files[kGameBattery] == saveOf(1000, 5));  // truncated by the open, not overlaid
    CHECK(rig.dev.filesOpen == 0);
}

TEST_CASE("a dump keeps the restore's bound and tells a missing folder from a card that will not list",
          "[n8][cart-jobs]") {
    Rig rig;
    rig.dev.files["EDN8/gamedata/empty.nes/bram.srm"] = {};
    rig.dev.files["EDN8/gamedata/huge.nes/bram.srm"] = Bytes((1u << 20) + 1, 0);
    rig.connect();
    const auto run = [&](JobRequest req) {
        Job j;
        REQUIRE(rig.submit(req, j));
        REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return j.finished() && !rig.host.cartJobBusy(); }));
        CHECK(j.state.load() == Job::Failed);
        return j.error;
    };
    CHECK(run(battery("dump", "empty.nes")) ==
          "the battery file EDN8/gamedata/empty.nes/bram.srm holds 0 bytes: a battery file is 1 to 1048576");
    CHECK(run(battery("dump", "huge.nes")) ==
          "the battery file EDN8/gamedata/huge.nes/bram.srm holds 1048577 bytes: a battery file is 1 to 1048576");
    CHECK(rig.dev.count("file-rd") == 0);
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(rig.dev.mu);
        rig.dev.failNextList = true;
    }
    CHECK(run(battery("dump", "empty.nes")) ==
          "the battery folder EDN8/gamedata/empty.nes could not be listed: Edio: operation error 0x01");
}

TEST_CASE("a battery job's name wins over the ROM this host booted, names are plain, and a port change forgets the "
          "booted ROM", "[n8][cart-jobs]") {
    Rig rig;
    rig.dev.files["EDN8/gamedata/other.nes/bram.srm"] = saveOf(700, 9);
    rig.connect();
    Job up;
    REQUIRE(rig.submit(uploadOf(inesImage(8)), up));  // boots game.nes
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return up.finished(); }));
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(rig.dev.mu);
        rig.dev.menu = true;  // power-cycled to the menu
    }
    rig.host.connect(true);
    Job named;
    REQUIRE(rig.submit(battery("dump", "other.nes"), named));
    REQUIRE(waitUntil([&] { return named.finished() && !rig.host.cartJobBusy(); }));
    CHECK(named.result == saveOf(700, 9));

    for (const std::string bad : {std::string("."), std::string(".."), std::string("a\\b"), std::string("a\0b", 3),
                                  std::string(256, 'x')}) {
        Job none;
        std::string why;
        auto r = request(RP_SYSTEM_SRAM_INTERFACE, "dump");
        r.name = bad;
        CHECK_FALSE(rig.submit(r, none, &why));
        CHECK(why == "a battery job names the ROM's file, a plain file name");
    }

    rig.host.connect(false);
    rig.host.setPort("/dev/another-cart");
    Job none;
    std::string why;
    CHECK_FALSE(rig.submit(request(RP_SYSTEM_SRAM_INTERFACE, "dump"), none, &why));
    CHECK(why == "a battery job needs the ROM's file name: name it, or boot the ROM through rom.upload first");
}
````
